name: attention-is-all-you-need
title: Attention Is All You Need: Build the Transformer From Scratch

parts.title: Tokenization and Batching
parts.description: Build the vocabulary, encode and decode token ids, and pack padded sequences into batched tensors.

parts.title: Embeddings and Positional Encoding
parts.description: Scale embeddings and construct the sinusoidal positional encoding matrix added to input embeddings.

parts.title: Masks and Scaled Dot-Product Attention
parts.description: Build padding and causal masks and assemble scaled dot-product attention step by step.

parts.title: Multi-Head Attention
parts.description: Split, permute, and merge heads, project Q/K/V, and assemble the full multi-head attention module.

parts.title: Feed-Forward, LayerNorm, and Dropout
parts.description: Implement the position-wise feed-forward network, layer normalization, residual add-and-norm, and dropout.

parts.title: Encoder, Decoder, and Full Model
parts.description: Stack encoder and decoder layers, tie output projections to embeddings, and run the complete forward pass.

parts.title: Parameter Initialization
parts.description: Allocate the raw weight tensors (with requires_grad) for encoder/decoder layers and embeddings.

parts.title: Training Objective and Schedule
parts.description: Implement teacher forcing, Noam warmup, label-smoothed KL loss, and token-level accuracy.

parts.title: Adam Optimizer From Scratch
parts.description: Build Adam step by step: moment buffers, EMA updates, bias correction, the update rule, and gradient zeroing.

parts.title: Training Step and Loop
parts.description: Run a forward pass, compute the label-smoothed loss, backpropagate, and step Adam across many iterations.

parts.title: Decoding and Beam Search
parts.description: Generate sequences with greedy argmax and a length-penalized beam search over candidate hypotheses.

steps.name: build_token_to_id_vocab
steps.doc: Build a token-to-id dict: the four special tokens first, then sorted unique whitespace tokens starting at id 4.

steps.name: build_id_to_token_vocab
steps.doc: Return the inverse mapping from id to token.

steps.name: encode_sentence_to_ids
steps.doc: Map a sentence's whitespace tokens to their ids, sending unknown tokens to the <unk> id 3, as a LongTensor.

steps.name: decode_ids_to_tokens
steps.doc: Map each id in the sequence back to its token string, returning a list.

steps.name: pad_id_sequence
steps.doc: Right-pad with pad_id or truncate the id tensor to exactly `length`, returning a LongTensor.

steps.name: stack_padded_sequences_to_batch
steps.doc: Pad every id sequence to the batch's max length and stack into a (B, Smax) LongTensor.

steps.name: scale_embeddings_by_sqrt_d_model
steps.doc: Scale token embeddings up by the square root of the model dimension.

steps.name: compute_positional_div_term
steps.doc: Compute the geometric frequency divisors for the sinusoidal positional encoding.

steps.name: build_position_index_column
steps.doc: Build a column vector of position indices as floats from 0 to max_len-1.

steps.name: fill_even_indices_with_sin
steps.doc: Write sine values into the even feature columns of the positional encoding table.

steps.name: fill_odd_indices_with_cos
steps.doc: Write cosine values into the odd feature columns of the positional encoding table.

steps.name: build_sinusoidal_positional_encoding
steps.doc: Assemble the full fixed sinusoidal positional encoding table of shape (max_len, d_model).

steps.name: add_positional_encoding_to_embeddings
steps.doc: Add the positional encoding to the embeddings, broadcasting over the batch dimension.

steps.name: build_padding_mask
steps.doc: Build a boolean mask marking real (non-pad) token positions for attention.

steps.name: build_causal_mask
steps.doc: Build a lower-triangular boolean mask allowing each position to attend only to earlier or equal positions.

steps.name: combine_padding_and_causal_masks
steps.doc: Combine padding and causal masks so a position is kept only if both allow it.

steps.name: compute_raw_attention_scores
steps.doc: Compute unnormalized attention scores as the dot products between queries and keys.

steps.name: scale_attention_scores
steps.doc: Scale attention scores down by the square root of the key dimension.

steps.name: mask_attention_scores_with_neg_inf
steps.doc: Replace blocked attention scores with a large negative value before softmax.

steps.name: softmax_attention_weights
steps.doc: Turn attention scores into a probability distribution over keys.

steps.name: apply_attention_weights_to_values
steps.doc: Form the attention output as the weighted sum of value vectors.

steps.name: scaled_dot_product_attention
steps.doc: Compute scaled dot-product attention output from queries, keys, values, and an optional keep-mask.

steps.name: split_last_dim_into_heads
steps.doc: Reshape the trailing model dimension into separate head and per-head feature dimensions.

steps.name: transpose_heads_before_sequence
steps.doc: Move the head dimension ahead of the sequence dimension.

steps.name: merge_heads_back_to_model_dim
steps.doc: Recombine the per-head features back into a single model dimension.

steps.name: apply_linear_projection
steps.doc: Apply an affine linear map using an (in, out)-shaped weight and bias.

steps.name: project_to_query_key_value
steps.doc: Linearly project inputs into query, key, and value representations.

steps.name: split_qkv_into_heads
steps.doc: Split each of query, key, and value into multiple attention heads.

steps.name: multi_head_scaled_dot_product_attention
steps.doc: Run scaled dot-product attention independently per head and recombine the results.

steps.name: merge_heads_and_project_output
steps.doc: Apply the output linear projection to the merged attention result.

steps.name: assemble_multi_head_attention_forward
steps.doc: Run the full multi-head attention block from inputs to projected output.

steps.name: apply_ffn_first_linear_and_relu
steps.doc: Project the input up to the feed-forward inner dimension and apply a ReLU nonlinearity.

steps.name: apply_ffn_second_linear
steps.doc: Project the inner feed-forward activations back down to the model dimension.

steps.name: position_wise_feed_forward_network
steps.doc: Run the two-layer position-wise feed-forward network with a ReLU in between.

steps.name: compute_layer_norm_mean_and_variance
steps.doc: Compute the per-position mean and biased variance over the last (feature) dimension, keeping dims.

steps.name: normalize_and_scale_with_gamma_beta
steps.signature: normalize_and_scale_with_gamma_beta(x, mean, var, gamma, beta, eps=1e-05)
steps.doc: Standardize the input with the given mean and variance, then apply the learned scale and shift.

steps.name: apply_residual_add_and_norm
steps.doc: Add the sublayer output to its input and layer-normalize the sum (post-norm residual).

steps.name: apply_dropout_with_keep_mask
steps.doc: Apply inverted dropout by zeroing masked elements and rescaling the survivors by 1/(1-p).

steps.name: encoder_layer_self_attention_sublayer
steps.doc: Run the encoder self-attention sublayer with a residual add-and-norm around it.

steps.name: encoder_layer_feed_forward_sublayer
steps.doc: Run the encoder position-wise feed-forward sublayer with a residual add-and-norm around it.

steps.name: assemble_encoder_layer
steps.doc: Apply one full encoder layer: self-attention sublayer then feed-forward sublayer.

steps.name: stack_encoder_layers
steps.doc: Pass the input through every encoder layer in sequence and return the final hidden states.

steps.name: decoder_layer_masked_self_attention_sublayer
steps.doc: Run the decoder masked self-attention sublayer with a residual add-and-norm around it.

steps.name: decoder_layer_cross_attention_sublayer
steps.doc: Run the decoder cross-attention sublayer attending to encoder memory with a residual add-and-norm.

steps.name: decoder_layer_feed_forward_sublayer
steps.doc: Run the decoder position-wise feed-forward sublayer with a residual add-and-norm around it.

steps.name: assemble_decoder_layer
steps.signature: assemble_decoder_layer(x, memory, layer, tgt_mask, src_mask, n_heads)
steps.doc: Apply one full decoder layer: masked self-attention, cross-attention, then feed-forward sublayers.

steps.name: stack_decoder_layers
steps.signature: stack_decoder_layers(x, memory, decoder_layers, tgt_mask, src_mask, n_heads)
steps.doc: Pass the input through every decoder layer in sequence and return the final hidden states.

steps.name: apply_final_output_projection
steps.doc: Project decoder hidden states to vocabulary logits using the (vocab,D) output weight and bias.

steps.name: tie_output_projection_to_token_embeddings
steps.doc: Return the token embedding matrix to be reused as the tied output projection weight.

steps.name: apply_log_softmax_over_vocab
steps.doc: Convert vocabulary logits into log-probabilities over the vocabulary dimension.

steps.name: run_transformer_forward
steps.doc: Run the full encoder-decoder Transformer and return log-probabilities over the vocabulary.

steps.name: init_encoder_layer_parameters
steps.doc: Create one encoder layer's parameter dict (self-attention, FFN, two layer norms) as small random leaf tensors that require gradients.

steps.name: init_decoder_layer_parameters
steps.doc: Create one decoder layer's parameter dict (self-attention, cross-attention, FFN, three layer norms) as small random leaf tensors that require gradients.

steps.name: init_embedding_and_projection_parameters
steps.doc: Create the token embedding matrix (vocab, d_model) and the output projection bias (vocab,) as leaf tensors that require gradients.

steps.name: collect_model_parameters_into_list
steps.doc: Gather every trainable leaf tensor in the model (embedding, output bias, and all encoder/decoder layer weights, biases, gammas, betas) into a single deterministically ordered list.

steps.name: shift_targets_right_with_start_token
steps.doc: Build the decoder input by prepending a start token column and dropping the final target position.

steps.name: compute_noam_learning_rate
steps.doc: Compute the Noam schedule learning rate for the given step, warming up linearly then decaying.

steps.name: build_uniform_smoothing_distribution
steps.doc: Create the (vocab,) target distribution filled with the off-target smoothing mass spread over non-target non-pad classes.

steps.name: set_confidence_on_gold_tokens
steps.doc: Place the confidence probability mass onto each row's gold-token column of the smoothing distribution.

steps.name: zero_pad_column_and_pad_token_rows
steps.doc: Zero out the pad-token column for every row and zero entire rows whose gold token is the pad token.

steps.name: compute_label_smoothed_kl_loss
steps.doc: Compute the total label-smoothed cross-entropy as the negative sum of target-weighted log probabilities.

steps.name: average_loss_over_non_pad_tokens
steps.doc: Normalize the summed loss by the number of non-pad target tokens.

steps.name: compute_token_accuracy_ignoring_pad
steps.doc: Compute the fraction of non-pad positions where the predicted argmax token matches the gold token.

steps.name: initialize_adam_optimizer_state
steps.doc: Create Adam state with zeroed first/second moment buffers for each parameter and a zero step counter.

steps.name: update_adam_first_moment
steps.doc: Return the exponential moving average of the gradient (Adam first moment update).

steps.name: update_adam_second_moment
steps.doc: Return the exponential moving average of the squared gradient (Adam second moment update).

steps.name: apply_adam_bias_correction
steps.doc: Return the bias-corrected moment estimate by dividing out the accumulated decay at step t.

steps.name: apply_adam_step_to_all_parameters
steps.doc: Advance the step, update moments and apply the in-place Adam parameter update for every parameter with a gradient.

steps.name: zero_all_parameter_gradients
steps.doc: Clear the stored gradient of every parameter so the next backward pass starts fresh.

steps.name: compute_batch_training_loss
steps.signature: compute_batch_training_loss(params, src_ids, tgt_ids, smoothing, pad_id=0, bos_id=1)
steps.doc: Forward the model on shifted decoder inputs and return the label-smoothed KL loss averaged over non-pad target tokens plus that token count.

steps.name: run_training_step_with_backprop
steps.signature: run_training_step_with_backprop(params, param_list, opt_state, src_ids, tgt_ids, lr, smoothing)
steps.doc: Run one optimization step: zero grads, compute the batch loss, backpropagate, apply an Adam update, and return the new optimizer state with the float loss value.

steps.name: run_training_loop_for_steps
steps.signature: run_training_loop_for_steps(params, src_ids, tgt_ids, n_steps, d_model, warmup, smoothing)
steps.doc: Train on a fixed batch for n_steps using a Noam-scheduled learning rate per step and return the list of per-step loss values.

steps.name: pick_next_token_by_argmax
steps.doc: Greedily choose each position's next token as the highest-scoring vocab entry.

steps.name: compute_length_penalty
steps.doc: Return the GNMT length-normalization factor for a hypothesis of the given length.

steps.name: compute_candidate_scores
steps.doc: Combine each beam's running log-prob with every possible next token's log-prob.

steps.name: select_top_k_candidates
steps.doc: Pick the k best (beam, token) candidates across the flattened score grid.

steps.name: append_tokens_to_beam_sequences
steps.doc: Extend each selected beam's sequence by its chosen next token.

steps.name: mark_finished_beams
steps.doc: Flag beams whose most recent token is the end-of-sequence symbol.

steps.name: select_best_finished_beam
steps.doc: Return the sequence whose length-normalized score is highest.
